phases.name: safejs-availability
phases.meaning: Execute the actual copied engine through its copied src/run.ts; require result.ok, not a mock or private-source execution.

phases.name: cold-typecheck
phases.meaning: Require the documented cold prerequisite refusal without a production compiler invocation.

phases.name: typecheck-all
phases.meaning: One actual audited production build, source/tests and maintained strict consumers/negatives; authenticate reuse of the emitted declaration set.

phases.name: benchmark-types
phases.meaning: Check the frozen benchmark TypeScript project with the bound benchmark compiler.

phases.name: env-source-binding
phases.meaning: Import frozen execution.ts and env-split.ts under their exact critical-source hashes.

phases.name: canonical
phases.meaning: Exact632 candidate paths, explicit TAP and concurrency2; reconcile all footer/case statuses and observed main-thread file coverage.

phases.name: current-consumers
phases.meaning: Use exact candidate inventory/runtime/type bodies and fences. The reviewed external verifier only replaces the cold/build seam and five import bindings; productionBuildsInThisPhase must be0.

phases.name: pack
phases.meaning: Offline script-disabled npm pack of the single built source; require complete expected c109 tarball SHA.

phases.name: public-runtime
phases.meaning: Moved-package permission-fenced exact76 registry, explicit imports, optional curl/SafeJS absence and five frozen public workflows.

phases.name: public-types
phases.meaning: Strict moved-package positive types with authenticated root/subpath resolution to the same candidate declarations.

phases.name: negative-types
phases.meaning: Require exact TS2305,TS2353,TS2353 diagnostic sequence; exit2 is an expected negative-control outcome.

phases.name: missing-root
phases.meaning: Remove root entry only in a separate test-owned package copy; require exit1 and ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND.

phases.name: missing-contracts
phases.meaning: Remove contracts entry only in a separate test-owned package copy; require exit1 and ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND.

phases.name: final-sweep
phases.meaning: Internal final ordered check of source/dependencies/driver/native/package/private state and exactly one audited production build; no subprocess for this row.

timeoutQualification: phase-runner clamps the canonical caller request of3600000ms to the reviewed1800000ms cap; current-consumers requests900000ms. Final sweep is internal and bounded by the outer deadline. Test-owned timeouts remain their exact source profile.
testCaseCountQualification: 632 canonical file paths are fixed; do not invent a total TAP test count. Actual reconciled pass/fail/SKIP/TODO/cancel and every missing path must be captured.
